description: As casscf.json's cases, from the same starts (the exact RHF's orbitals and the same 'active' or AVAS pick), with PySCF mcscf.CASSCF(...).density_fit(auxbasis=...): every two-electron quantity of the CASSCF, the core's J and K included, over the fitted integrals, gated against mc2step and polished to |g| < 1e-10 as there. The fitting set is this tree's data/aux_basis file each case's 'aux_basis' names, handed to PySCF as parsed shells, not its library copy. A case with 'scf' 'rohf' starts instead from PySCF's DF-ROHF orbitals over that set (at its 'multiplicity', conv_tol 1e-14, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), its 'rhf_energy' and 'mo_energies' that ROHF's, and has no exact counterpart. Hartree; coordinates in bohr
